mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders (member_id, total_amount, shipping_fee, order_number, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{totalAmount}, #{shippingFee}, #{orderNumber}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW());

INSERT INTO order_detail (orders_id, product_id, quantity, price, created_at) VALUES
(#{orderItem.ordersId}, #{orderItem.productId}, #{orderItem.quantity}, #{orderItem.price}, NOW())
mapper.select: select od.order_detail_id, od.orders_id, od.product_id, od.price , od.quantity, od.price * quantity as amount, p.name as pname, p.image_url as imageUrl from order_detail od inner join product p on od.product_id = p.product_id where orders_id = (select orders_id from orders where order_number = #{orderNumber})

select od.order_detail_id, od.price, od.quantity, p.product_id, p.name as pname, p.image_url as imageUrl, o.orders_id, o.order_number as orderNumber, o.total_amount as totalAmount, o.created_at as createdAt, o.status as status from order_detail od inner join product p on od.product_id = p.product_id inner join orders o on od.orders_id = o.orders_id where od.orders_id IN (select orders_id from orders where member_id = #{memberId}) ORDER BY od.orders_id DESC
